newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - APRIL 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - APRIL 10.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press. Today's press digest is late due to a work stoppage by newspaper distributors this morning.

--Despite construction workers descending in force yesterday on the labour ministry against proposed changes to the job market, Prime Minister Costas Simitis insisted last night that the labour market was in need of reorganisation.

--Defence Minister Akis Tsohatzopoulos is considering an increase in the size of the Greek mission to Albania, following his meeting with his Albanian counterpart yesterday. A team of 15-20 will head to Albania tomorrow.

--Interior Minister Alekos Papadopoulos has issued an order to all public service and organisations (DEKOs) to stop hiring new personnel, as part of efforts to drastically cut back on public expenditures. Similar efforts are under way at the national economy ministry.
